title: AS2 DefineFunction2 preload/suppress flags always 0x0000
description: DefineFunction2 preload/suppress bits (PreloadThis bit1, SuppressArguments bit7) are always written as zeros in compiler.ts line 1771. Setting these flags avoids slow scope-chain lookups for this/super in class methods and matches real Flash 8 output. Fixes register-slot allocation for arguments.
